grammarItem: X は Y です (Topic and Noun Predicate)
instructionalDetails: Topic marker は (pronounced wa); noun predicate with です; contextual omission of understood topic; nouns lack gender/article/number marking.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 41-42 (PDF pp. 49-50, review-g1-49.png, review-g1-50.png). Verified topic omission, noun predicate, and particle wa.

grammarItem: Question Sentences with か (Interrogative Particle)
instructionalDetails: Sentence-final particle か forms questions without word order change or rising pitch markers; answers with はい and いいえ.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed p. 42 (PDF p. 50). Verified yes/no questions with はい/いいえ, question word 何 (なん before です/counters, なに before particles), and punctuation omission of ?.

grammarItem: Noun の Noun (Noun Modification & Possession)
instructionalDetails: の links two nouns where the first restricts or modifies the second (possession, affiliation, category).
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed p. 43 (PDF p. 51). Verified Noun1 (modifier/restriction) + の + Noun2 (main idea), possession, affiliation, and chained noun clauses.

grammarItem: Time and Age Counters (時・分・歳・半)
instructionalDetails: Hours (何時, 四時, 七時, 九時), minutes with phonological shifts (一分, 三分, 四分, 六分, 八分, 十分じゅっぷん), ages (一歳, 八歳, 十歳, 二十歳はたち), and 半.
evidence: Audited in 2026-11-17 supervision pass. Verified minute sound changes, contrast between じゅっぷん and じゅうぶん.

grammarItem: Demonstrative Pronouns (これ・それ・あれ・どれ)
instructionalDetails: Ko-so-a-do series pointing to proximity to speaker, listener, or distance from both, and question word どれ.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed p. 60 (PDF p. 68). Verified proximity zones (kore/sore/are), question word dore taking ga not wa, and politeness rule avoiding re-series for people in earshot.

grammarItem: Demonstrative Modifiers (この・その・あの・どの + Noun)
instructionalDetails: Adnominal series directly modifying nouns; cannot stand alone as independent pronouns.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed p. 61 (PDF p. 69). Verified adnominal modifier requirement (+ Noun), polite human reference (kono gakusee/kata), and question word dono taking ga.

grammarItem: Place Demonstratives (ここ・そこ・あそこ・どこ)
instructionalDetails: Location demonstratives pointing to speaker space, listener space, or distant location.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed p. 62 (PDF p. 70). Verified location demonstratives koko, soko, asoko, doko and asking directions with wa doko desu ka.

grammarItem: だれの Noun (Interrogative Possessive)
instructionalDetails: Asking for ownership/affiliation; answers with Noun の (possessive pronoun omission).
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed pp. 62, 64 (PDF pp. 70, 72). Verified dare no Noun asking ownership, noun omission after no in replies, and sentence particles ne (agreement) and yo (informing).

grammarItem: Noun も (Inclusive Particle 'Also/Too')
instructionalDetails: Replaces は/が/を to indicate similarity with previously established predicate.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed pp. 62-63 (PDF pp. 70-71). Verified particle mo replacing wa/ga/o, strict positioning after the shared-property entity, and demo restriction for secondary attributes.

grammarItem: Noun じゃないです / じゃありません (Negative Noun Predicate)
instructionalDetails: Colloquial negative じゃないです versus formal じゃありません / ではありません.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed pp. 63-64 (PDF pp. 71-72). Verified negative noun predicate registers (janai desu, jaarimasen, dewa arimasen), ban on negating i-adjectives with janai desu, and ban on isolated desu/janai in short replies.

grammarItem: Verb Conjugation: Ru-verbs, U-verbs, Irregular verbs
instructionalDetails: Three verb groups; polite non-past affirmative 〜ます and negative 〜ません; vowel base shifts.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed pp. 86-88 (PDF pp. 94-96). Verified Ru-verb vs U-verb vs Irregular classification, u-to-i base shift, and irregular u-verb exception kaeru.

grammarItem: Particles を, で, に, へ (Object, Means/Location of Action, Time, Goal)
instructionalDetails: を direct object; で location of action/means; に specific time/goal; へ direction.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed pp. 88-90 (PDF pp. 96-98). Verified object marker o (pronounced o), dynamic action location de, goal ni/he (pronounced e), and flexible word order.

grammarItem: Time References: Numerical Time vs Relative Time (に Usage)
instructionalDetails: Days of week and specific numbers take に; relative words (今日, 明日, 毎日) do not take に.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed pp. 89-90 (PDF pp. 97-98). Verified time marker ni with days of week/specific numbers, and strict ban on ni with relative time words (kyoo, ashita, kinook, maiasa, itsu).

grammarItem: 〜ませんか (Polite Invitation)
instructionalDetails: Negative question functioning as an invitation ('Won't you...?').
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed p. 90 (PDF p. 98). Verified negative question masenka as polite invitation, distinction from factual affirmative masuka, and polite soft refusal with chotto.

grammarItem: Frequency Adverbs (毎日・よく・時々・あまり・全然)
instructionalDetails: Positive adverbs (よく, 時々) vs negative polarity adverbs requiring negative predicate (あまり, 全然).
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed p. 91 (PDF p. 99). Verified positive frequency adverbs (mainichi, yoku, tokidoki) vs negative polarity adverbs (amari, zenzen requiring negative predicates).

grammarItem: Past Tense of Verbs and です (〜ました・〜ませんでした・〜でした)
instructionalDetails: Past affirmative 〜ました, negative 〜ませんでした. Copula past affirmative でした, negative じゃありませんでした / じゃなかったです / ではありませんでした.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed pp. 110-111 (PDF pp. 118-119). Verified past forms for ru-verbs, u-verbs, irregulars, and three negative registers of past copula.

grammarItem: Location Words (上・下・前・後ろ・中・隣・近く・間)
instructionalDetails: Relative position formula X は Y の [位置] にあります/います. Adjacent neighbor となり (same category only) vs そば/よこ/近く. Dynamic actions taking で.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed pp. 106, 108-109 (PDF pp. 114, 116-117). Verified 10 spatial relational nouns, tonari same-category constraint, and dynamic action de.

grammarItem: あります and います (Existence, Possession, and Events)
instructionalDetails: Inanimate あります vs animate います. Station location takes に. Event taking place takes で (お祭りがあります). Negative possession (テレビがありません) vs negative copula.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed pp. 107-108 (PDF pp. 115-116). Verified animate/inanimate distinction, stationary に vs event de, and possession.

grammarItem: Duration, Quantities, and Particle と
instructionalDetails: Duration expressed as bare noun without に (一時間). Particle と connecting nouns (A と B) and companion (together with). Particle も combinations (にも, へも, でも).
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed pp. 111-113 (PDF pp. 119-121). Verified duration bare noun rule, particle to dual functions, and compound particle mo combinations.

grammarItem: Adjectives Conjugation & Noun Modification (い-adjectives & な-adjectives)
instructionalDetails: 4-quadrant conjugation matrix for present/past x affirmative/negative. Irregular adjective いい (forms based on よい). Noun modification (い-adj direct, な-adj + な). Isogashii restricted to people.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed pp. 132-134 (PDF pp. 140-142). Verified i-adj and na-adj conjugation rules, irregular ii->yoi shift, noun modification with na, and person-only isogashii constraint.

grammarItem: 好き（な） and 嫌い（な） (Likes and Dislikes with が)
instructionalDetails: Grammatically na-adjectives taking particle が for target object. Contrast particle は replacement. Intensified daisuki/daikirai vs totemo suki. Neutral suki demo kirai demo nai.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed p. 135 (PDF p. 143). Verified na-adj status, target marking with ga, contrastive wa substitution, and intensified/neutral forms.

grammarItem: 〜ましょう and 〜ましょうか (Let's and Shall We?)
instructionalDetails: Verb stem + ましょう (enthusiastic proposal/let's). Verb stem + ましょうか (shall we / offering assistance).
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed p. 136 (PDF p. 144). Verified mashou for let's and mashou ka for mutual suggestion and offering personal assistance.

grammarItem: Counting and Number Word Position (枚 and Item Order)
instructionalDetails: Flat item counter 枚 (まい). Number word positioning after item + を in sentences (Tシャツを三枚買いました). General counters hitotsu, futatsu, mittsu.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed p. 136 (PDF p. 144). Verified flat object counter mai, word order item + o + quantity + verb, and general native counters.

grammarItem: Te-form Conjugation, Sequence of Actions, and Prohibition (〜てはいけません)
instructionalDetails: 5 sub-rules for u-verbs, ru-verbs, irregulars (suru/kuru), and exception iku->itte. Sequential action chaining with te-form (verbs cannot take particle to). Strong prohibition with te wa ikemasen.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed pp. 150-152 (PDF pp. 158-160). Verified 5 u-verb sub-rules, exception iku->itte, sequential te-chaining, and prohibition te wa ikemasen.

grammarItem: 〜てください (Polite Request)
instructionalDetails: V-te + kudasai for polite request/instruction. Bare te-form for close friends/family. Register advice for superiors.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed p. 151 (PDF p. 159). Verified te kudasai instruction/request and bare te-form informal requests.

grammarItem: 〜てもいいですか and 〜てもいいです (Permission)
instructionalDetails: Asking permission (te mo ii desu ka) and granting permission (te mo ii desu / hai, ii desu yo / doozo). Ban on isolated *te mo ii desu without verb. Spoken omission of mo.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed p. 152 (PDF p. 160). Verified asking/granting permission, graceful replies with doozo, and ban on isolated short answers.

grammarItem: 〜から (Reason Clause Linker)
instructionalDetails: [Explanation] から、[Situation]. Explaining causes and reasons. Sentence ordering variants (explanation first vs situation first).
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed p. 153 (PDF p. 161). Verified kara clause linking, explanation-situation order, and polite desu kara.

grammarItem: 〜ている (Action in Progress vs Resultant State)
instructionalDetails: Activity verbs (continuous action/occupation) vs change verbs (instantaneous change resulting in state: 結婚している, 座っている, 持っている, 太っている, 住んでいる). Movement verbs 行く/来る indicating prior arrival. Negative of 知る strictly 知りません.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed pp. 170-172 (PDF pp. 178-180). Verified duration vs change classification, occupation reading, result of change, and shiru negative rule.

grammarItem: Describing People (Person は Body Part が [Adjective] です)
instructionalDetails: Idiomatic description of physical appearance. Collocations: 背が高い/低い, 頭がいい, 目がいい/悪い.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed pp. 172-173 (PDF pp. 180-181). Verified body part topic/subject formula and idiomatic height/intelligence collocations.

grammarItem: Adjective and Noun Te-forms for Joining Sentences (〜くて / 〜で)
instructionalDetails: い-adjective drop い + くて (irregular いい -> よくて). な-adjective and Noun + で. Final predicate tense dictates sentence tense.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed p. 173 (PDF p. 181). Verified i-adj kute, irregular ii->yokute, na-adj/noun de, and final predicate tense agreement.

grammarItem: Verb Stem + に行く / に来る (Movement Purpose)
instructionalDetails: Destination に/へ + V-stem に + 行く/来る/帰る. Activity noun replacement (買い物に行く).
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed p. 174 (PDF p. 182). Verified destination markers ni/he, verb stem before purpose ni, and activity nouns.

grammarItem: Counting People (一人, 二人, 四人, etc.)
instructionalDetails: People counter 人. Irregulars: ひとり, ふたり, よにん (ban on shinin/yonnin). Positioning after particle (が一人います).
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed pp. 174-175 (PDF pp. 182-183). Verified irregular people counts hitori, futari, yonin, and interrogative nannin.

grammarItem: Short Forms and Quoted Speech (〜と思う / 〜と言う)
instructionalDetails: Plain present negative conjugation (ru-verbs, u-verbs ending in u taking wanai, irregulars, aru->nai). Quoted speech formula [Short Form] + to omoimasu / to iimashita. Mandatory だ after nouns/na-adjectives before と. Thought negation preference (〜nai to omoimasu).
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed pp. 190-194 (PDF pp. 198-202). Verified short form paradigm, irregular negative aru->nai, quotation particle to, mandatory da before to, and inner thought negation.

grammarItem: 〜ないでください (Negative Request)
instructionalDetails: V-short negative + でください. Polite negative request/instruction on signs and exams.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed p. 194 (PDF p. 202). Verified V-nai de kudasai formation, courteous prohibition, and sign instructions.

grammarItem: 動詞の「の」名詞化 (Verb Nominalization: のが好き / 上手 / 下手)
instructionalDetails: Turns action verb into noun phrase using nominalizer の: V-dictionary form + のが好き / 上手 / 下手. Internal object takes を.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed p. 195 (PDF p. 203). Verified nominalizer no, internal clause object particle o retention, and evaluative adjectives.

grammarItem: が vs は (Subject Selection) and 何か・何も (Indefinite Pronouns)
instructionalDetails: Question words as subjects strictly take が (dare ga, nani ga). Answering subject takes が. 何か (something/anything) and 何も + negative (nothing). Omission of particles は/が/を after nanika/nanimo.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed pp. 195-196 (PDF pp. 203-204). Verified question word subject ga rule, answering subject ga rule, and indefinite pronouns nanika/nanimo particle dropping.

grammarItem: もう〜ました vs まだ〜ていません (Already Done vs Have Not Yet Done)
instructionalDetails: Affirmative mou + V-mashita (action already completed). Negative mada + V-te imasen (action not yet done). Critical ban on *mada V-masen deshita (past negative is strictly for closed past timeframes, not ongoing uncompleted actions).
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed p. 217 (PDF p. 225). Verified mou + past affirmative, mada + te imasen, and ban on past negative with mada.

grammarItem: Past Short Forms and Relative Clauses (Qualifying Nouns with Sentences)
instructionalDetails: Past short form paradigm (verbs te/de -> ta/da, nai -> nakatta; i-adj katta/kunakatta; na-adj & nouns datta/janakatta). Retention of datta in informal past speech. Noun-modifying relative clauses strictly preceding nouns without relative pronouns, with short-form predicates. No tense backshift in reported speech.
evidence: Direct visual inspection of printed pp. 214-218 (PDF pp. 222-226). Verified past short form paradigm, noun-modifying relative clauses without relative pronouns, and absence of sequence-of-tense shift in reported speech.

grammarItem: 〜あまり / 〜のあまり
instructionalDetails: Covers 〜あまり / 〜のあまり. Extreme intensity of emotional or mental state leading to an unusual, spontaneous, or adverse consequence beyond normal control (e.g. 驚きのあまり, 緊張のあまり).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N2 pp. 74-77. Verified extreme emotional state consequence instruction, formation rules (Noun + のあまり / Verb-plain + あまり), 6 sentence examples, and chapter practice exercises.

grammarItem: 比較 (Comparison between Two Items) & どちら
instructionalDetails: AのほうがBより [Property] です; reverse order BよりAのほうが; comparative question AとBとどちらが [Property] ですか; prohibition of どちら/のほう for 3+ items.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 234-235 (PDF pp. 242-243, p242_printed234.png, p243_printed235.png). Verified comparative sentence structures, reverse particle order note, and どちら restrictions.

grammarItem: 形容詞/名詞 + の (Noun Substitute 'no')
instructionalDetails: Indefinite noun substitute の replacing understood items to avoid repetition (赤いの, 好きなの, メアリーさんの); retention of な for な-adjectives; strict prohibition against referring to people (use 人).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 235-236 (PDF pp. 243-244, p243_printed235.png, p244_printed236.png). Verified noun substitute rules, footnote 4 inanimate restriction, and な-adj retaining な.

grammarItem: 〜つもりだ / つもりです (Stated Personal Intention)
instructionalDetails: V(short present) + つもりだ/です for conscious personal future plan; negative plan V-ない + つもりです (or V-る + つもりはありません); past intention つもりでした (unrealized plan); social restriction against asking superiors.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 236 (PDF p. 244, p244_printed236.png). Verified short present connection, negative intention patterns, and unrealized intention with つもりでした.

grammarItem: 形容詞 + なる (Change of State: To Become)
instructionalDetails: Adverbial transformation before なる: い-adj (drop い) + くなる (暖かくなる, いい→よくなる); な-adj stem + になる (静かになる); Noun + になる (医者になる); explicit warning against *暖かになる; absolute vs relative change with より.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 236-237 (PDF pp. 244-245, p244_printed236.png, p245_printed237.png). Verified adverbial conjugation paradigms, *暖かになる trap warning, and relative change with より.

grammarItem: どこかに・どこにも・で (Indefinite Place Pronouns & Instrumental Particle)
instructionalDetails: どこか(へ/に) in affirmative clauses; どこにも / どこへも with negative predicates (preserves particles に/へ before も); instrumental で for transportation/tools; walking exception 歩いて行く (no で).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 237-238 (PDF pp. 245-246, p245_printed237.png, p246_printed238.png). Verified indefinite pronoun particle behavior, instrumental で usage, and walking exception.

grammarItem: 〜たい / 〜たくない (Expressing Desire to Do)
instructionalDetails: V-stem + たいです (conjugates like い-adj); direct object takes either を or が; long-held desires with 〜たいと思っています; third-person desires require quotation (〜と言っていました) or observation verb 〜たがっている (which takes ONLY を, never が).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 258-259 (PDF pp. 266-267, p266_printed258.png, p267_printed259.png). Verified object particle alternation (を/が), third-person 〜たがっている behavior, and prohibition against *が.

grammarItem: 〜たり〜たりする・や (Representative Activities & Non-Exhaustive Listing)
instructionalDetails: V-た + り、V-た + りする for non-exhaustive activities in no chronological sequence (tense on final する); Noun や Noun for non-exhaustive noun listing; contrastive は in negative sentences replacing を/が.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 259-261 (PDF pp. 267-269, p267_printed259.png, p268_printed260.png, p269_printed261.png). Verified non-exhaustive activity semantics, tense carried by final する, and noun linker や.

grammarItem: 〜ことがある (Past Experiential Aspect)
instructionalDetails: V-た + ことがある / あります for historical experience; negative 〜たことがありません; response etiquette with はい、あります (never *はい、そうです); Footnote 1 contrast between lack of experience (〜たことがない) vs pending expectation (まだ〜ていません); pairing with だけ.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 260-261 (PDF pp. 268-269, p268_printed260.png, p269_printed261.png). Verified past short form attachment, answer convention, and footnote 1 comparison with まだ〜ていません.

grammarItem: 〜んです (Explanatory Mode)
instructionalDetails: Short form + んです for explanations and clarifications; mandatory な insertion for nouns and な-adjectives in present affirmative (静かなんです, 学生なんです; ban on *だんです); invariant ending (preceding short form holds tense/polarity); どうしたんですか question etiquette with が subject marker; formal written のです and casual んだ.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 276-277 (PDF pp. 284-285, p284_printed276.png, p285_printed277.png). Verified explanatory mode mechanics, な insertion on nouns/な-adjectives, and question clarifications.

grammarItem: 〜すぎる (Excessiveness: Too Much / Overdoing)
instructionalDetails: V-stem / い-adj (drop い) / な-adj (drop な) + すぎる; regular Ru-verb conjugation; indicates unwelcome excess beyond proper degree (not a simple compliment); noun form 〜すぎ.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 278 (PDF p. 286, p286_printed278.png). Verified Ru-verb conjugation, adjective base attachment, and caution against using with compliments.

grammarItem: 〜ほうがいいです (Giving Advice: Had Better)
instructionalDetails: Advice asymmetry: affirmative advice uses past short form (V-た + ほうがいいです), negative advice uses present short form (V-ない + ほうがいいです); ban on *V-る + ほうがいいです for specific advice; pragmatic softening with よ/ね.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 278 (PDF p. 286, p286_printed278.png). Verified strict tense asymmetry between affirmative past advice and negative present advice.

grammarItem: 〜ので (Reason / Background Circumstance)
instructionalDetails: Clause(short form) + ので for objective reasons; contrast with から (more formal, courteous, objective circumstance); mandatory な insertion for nouns and な-adjectives in present affirmative (日曜日なので, いじわるなので; ban on *だので).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 279-280 (PDF pp. 287-288, p287_printed279.png, p288_printed280.png). Verified objective causal framing, comparison to から, and mandatory な insertion.

grammarItem: 〜なければいけません / なきゃいけません (Obligation: Must Do)
instructionalDetails: V-ない (drop い) + ければいけません (formal written) / なきゃいけません (colloquial spoken); double negative structural logic; past obligation with 〜いけませんでした.
evidence: Visual inspection of printed p. 280 (PDF p. 288, p288_printed280.png). Verified negative stem attachment, double negative etymology, and spoken casual contractions.

grammarItem: 〜でしょう / 〜だろう (Conjecture & Probability: Probably)
instructionalDetails: Short form + でしょう for conjecture/probability; interrogative 〜でしょうか for polite tentative queries; paired with adverb たぶん; CRITICAL BAN on だ for nouns and な-adjectives (雨でしょう, トマトは野菜でしょう; strictly prohibited: *野菜だでしょう).
evidence: Visual inspection of printed pp. 280-281 (PDF pp. 288-289, p288_printed280.png, p289_printed281.png). Verified probability semantics, tentative polite query usage, and strict ban on だ.

instructionalDetails: Ru-verbs: -rareru (見られる, 食べられる; spoken ra-less -reru); U-verbs: -eru (行ける, 読める, 泳げる); irregulars: くる→こられる, する→できる; potential verbs conjugate as Ru-verbs; direct object を standardly switches to が (漢字が読める); できる takes が; other particles (に, で, へ) remain unchanged.

grammarItem: 命令・禁止・〜こと (Imperatives, Prohibitions & Written Directives)

grammarItem: 文の組み立て 1: 引用 (Quotation & Citation Structure)
instructionalDetails: Structural quotation frames: direct speech brackets with 言って, indirect speech with と伝える/思う, indirect imperatives with ように言う, content-specifying という, and formal transmission with とのことだ.
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N3 pp. 104-105. Verified sentence arrangement 1: quotation & citation structures (~という, ~と伝える, ~と言われている), star-order syntax, 12 verified practice questions (skm3-p2-c1-q1 to q12) with full permutation, star position, and keyed option validation.

grammarItem: 文の組み立て 2: 名詞の説明 (Noun Modification & Description Structures)
instructionalDetails: Prenominal relative clause syntax: verb/adjective clauses preceding nouns, particle compounds with の (への/からの/での; strict ban on *にの), compound postposition modifiers (についての/に対する/としての), and mimetic state modifiers with の.

grammarItem: 文の組み立て 3: 「という」・「といった」 (Naming, Content & Representative Listing)
instructionalDetails: Clausal sentence architecture: naming entities (固有名称＋という), conveying propositional content (知らせ/噂＋という), formal definition frames (〜とは…のことだ), and representative example listing under general categories (AやB＋といった＋包括名詞).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N3 pp. 108-109. Verified sentence arrangement 3: naming, content & representative listing (〜という, 〜といった, 〜とのこと), 12 verified practice questions (skm3-p2-c3-q1 to q12).

grammarItem: 文の組み立て 4: 決まった形 (Fixed Syntactic Patterns & Paired Formulas)
instructionalDetails: Mastery of fixed correlative pairs: continuous span (〜から〜にかけて), objective regard (〜を〜として/とする/とした), baseline expansion (〜はもちろん), prerequisite (〜さえ〜ば), repeating concession (〜ことは〜が), and proportional increase (〜ば〜ほど).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N3 pp. 110-111. Verified sentence arrangement 4: fixed syntactic patterns & paired formulas (~ば~ほど, ~だけでなく~も, ~から~にかけて), 12 verified practice questions (skm3-p2-c4-q1 to q12).

grammarItem: 文章の文法 1: 文の始めと終わりの対応 (Sentence Head-Tail Harmony)
instructionalDetails: Discourse head-tail harmony: matching opening adverbs with closing modals (なぜなら〜からだ, たとえ〜ても, まるで〜ようだ, もし〜ものなら).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N3 pp. 116-117. Verified sentence head-tail harmony in discourse (文の始めと終わりの呼応: なぜなら~からだ, まるで~ようだ, まさか~とは思わなかった, 決して~ない, 必ずしも~とは限らない, 果たして~だろうか), 12 chapter exercises (skm3-p3-c1-q1 to q12) with rich distractor analysis.

grammarItem: 文章の文法 2: 時制と「〜ている」 (Narrative Tense & Aspect in Discourse)
instructionalDetails: Timeline narrative cohesion: relative tense in subordinate clauses (前に vs 後で) and aspectual differentiation of 〜ている (ongoing vs persisting state).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N3 pp. 118-121. Verified narrative tense & aspect in extended discourse (時制の照応: ル形/タ形/テイル形/テアル形, 過去回想 vs 一般真理 vs 現在進行 vs 結果残存), 12 chapter exercises (skm3-p3-c2-q1 to q12).

grammarItem: 文章の文法 3: 自動詞・他動詞の視点 (Transitivity & Speaker Standpoint)
instructionalDetails: Transitivity pair alignment: intransitive verbs for neutral objective state changes versus transitive verbs for intentional human agency and culpability.
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N3 pp. 122-123. Verified transitivity & speaker standpoint in text (自動詞 vs 他動詞の視点配分: 自然現象・客観変化 vs 人為的行為・意志的関与), 12 chapter exercises (skm3-p3-c3-q1 to q12).

grammarItem: 文章の文法 4: 〜ていく・〜てくる (Directional & Temporal Vectors in Text)
instructionalDetails: Spatial and chronological vector management: physical/temporal movement toward speaker (〜てくる) versus movement away/into future (〜ていく).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N3 pp. 124-127. Verified directional & temporal vectors in discourse (~ていく vs ~てくる: 空間的接近/離反, 過去からの蓄積/現在からの未来進展, 感情・現象の出現/消失), 12 chapter exercises (skm3-p3-c4-q1 to q12).

grammarItem: 文章の文法 5: 受身・使役・使役受身 (Voice & Subject Alignment in Discourse)
instructionalDetails: Voice harmonization across paragraph boundaries: preserving consistent speaker subject through passive (迷惑受身) and causative-passive.
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N3 pp. 128-129. Verified voice & subject alignment in discourse (受身・使役・使役受身: 視点の統一, 迷惑受身, 使役による他者への関与, 使役受身による不本意な強制), 12 chapter exercises (skm3-p3-c5-q1 to q12).

grammarItem: 文章の文法 6: 授受の視点 (Benefactive Standpoint: てやる・てもらう・てくれる)
instructionalDetails: Benefactive directional flow: favors directed toward speaker (〜てくれる/くださる) versus favors initiated/received by speaker (〜てもらう/いただく).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N3 pp. 130-133. Verified benefactive standpoint in text (授受の視点: てやる・てもらう・てくれる, 敬語授受 てさしあげる・ていただく・てくださる, 恩恵の主客関係と視点一貫性), 12 chapter exercises (skm3-p3-c6-q1 to q12).

grammarItem: 文章の文法 7: 指示表現「こそあど」 (Demonstrative Cohesion in Text)
instructionalDetails: Discourse referential chaining: こ-series for immediate focal elements, そ-series for textual anaphora, and あ-series for shared experiential recall.
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N3 pp. 134-135. Verified demonstrative cohesion in discourse (指示表現「こそあど」: 文脈指示 こ・そ・あ, 直前話題照応の「そ」, 話題提起の「こ」, 共有記憶想起の「あ」), 12 chapter exercises (skm3-p3-c7-q1 to q12).

grammarItem: 文章の文法 8: 助詞「は」と「が」 (Topic & Grammatical Subject in Text Cohesion)
instructionalDetails: Information structure distribution: が for brand-new introduction and subordinate clause subjects; は for topical thematic maintenance and contrast.

grammarItem: 文章の文法 9: 接続表現 (Discourse Connectives & Logical Progression)
instructionalDetails: Discourse markers governing paragraph logic: causal (そのため/したがって), adversative (しかし/ところが/一方で), and additive (さらに/その上).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N3 pp. 140-141. Verified discourse connectives & logical progression (接続表現: 逆接, 順接, 転換, 添加, 要約, 理由説明), 12 chapter exercises (skm3-p3-c9-q1 to q12).

grammarItem: 文章の文法 10: 文章の雰囲気の統一 (Stylistic Register & Tone Unity)
instructionalDetails: Stylistic register consistency: uncompromised uniformity between plain style (だ・である) for essays/reports and polite style (です・ます) for formal address.

grammarItem: 〜にかけては
instructionalDetails: Covers 〜にかけては. Designates a specific specialized domain or skill in which the subject demonstrates unrivaled, supreme mastery (e.g. プログラミングの技術にかけては, 彫刻の技にかけては).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N2 pp. 34-37. Verified domain mastery instruction, pragmatic predicate restriction (右に出る者はいない / 誰にも負けない), sentence examples, and chapter practice exercises (skm2-p1-c7-q3, q8).

grammarItem: 〜に関して / 〜に関する
instructionalDetails: Covers 〜に関して / 〜に関し / 〜に関する＋名詞. Formal, objective designation of an inquiry, investigation, research, or report topic (e.g. 不祥事の真相に関して, 海洋生態系に関する学術論文).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N2 pp. 34-37. Verified formal inquiry/topic instruction, noun modification rules, sentence examples, and chapter practice exercises (skm2-p1-c7-q4, q9).

grammarItem: 〜に対して / 〜に対する
instructionalDetails: Covers 〜に対して / 〜に対し / 〜に対する＋名詞. Indicates direction of attitude, demeanor, or response directed towards persons or external actions (e.g. 上司に対して, クレームに対して).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N2 pp. 34-37. Verified target-of-attitude instruction, contrast vs にこたえて, sentence examples, and chapter practice exercises (skm2-p1-c7-q5, q10).

grammarItem: 〜に基づいて / 〜をもとに
instructionalDetails: Covers 〜に基づいて (founded upon verifiable facts, data, laws, or physical evidence) vs 〜をもとに（して） (taking raw experience, ideas, or motifs as material for new creations).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N2 pp. 38-41. Verified data/evidence grounding vs creative raw material distinction, sentence examples, and chapter practice exercises (skm2-p1-c8-q1, q2, q7, q11, q12).

grammarItem: 〜に沿って / 〜に沿った
instructionalDetails: Covers 〜に沿って / 〜に沿い / 〜に沿った＋名詞. Strictly following guidelines, policies, sequential manuals, or outlines without deviation (e.g. 基本方針に沿って, 業務マニュアルに沿って).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N2 pp. 38-41. Verified guideline/manual compliance instruction, sentence examples, and chapter practice exercises (skm2-p1-c8-q3, q8).

grammarItem: 〜のもとで / 〜のもとに
instructionalDetails: Covers 〜のもとで (under human guidance, supervision, training, or nurturing: 名指揮者の指導のもとで) vs 〜のもとに (under formal principles, conditions, or governing rules: プライバシー保護方針のもとに).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N2 pp. 38-41. Verified mentorship vs governing principle distinction, sentence examples, and chapter practice exercises (skm2-p1-c8-q4, q9).

grammarItem: 〜向けに / 〜向けだ / 〜向けの
instructionalDetails: Covers 〜向けに / 〜向けだ / 〜向けの＋名詞. Purposeful engineering or tailoring of goods, tools, or services aimed at a specific demographic (e.g. 初級学習者向けに, シニア層向けに).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N2 pp. 38-41. Verified target demographic design instruction, sentence examples, and chapter practice exercises (skm2-p1-c8-q5, q10).

grammarItem: 〜につれて / 〜にしたがって
instructionalDetails: Covers 〜につれて (unidirectional natural progression driving proportional change: 山頂に近づくにつれて, 年齢を重ねるにつれて) vs 〜にしたがって (rule-based, gradient, or sequential correlation: 景気回復が進むにしたがって, 技術革新が加速するにしたがって).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N2 pp. 42-45. Verified proportional progression and gradient correlation instruction, sentence examples, and chapter practice exercises (skm2-p1-c9-q1, q2, q8, q9).

grammarItem: 〜に応じて / 〜に応じた
instructionalDetails: Covers 〜に応じて / 〜に応じ / 〜に応じた＋名詞. Flexible adaptation or scaling commensurate with individual variations in ability, budget, schedule, or request (e.g. レベルに応じて, ご予算や希望納期に応じて).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N2 pp. 42-45. Verified adaptive commensurate scaling instruction, sentence examples, and chapter practice exercises (skm2-p1-c9-q5, q11).

grammarItem: 〜に伴って / 〜とともに
instructionalDetails: Covers 〜に伴って / 〜に伴い (concomitant secondary impact of large events: グローバル化に伴って, 開発の進行に伴い) vs 〜とともに (twin macro shifts proceeding side by side: 少子高齢化の進展とともに).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N2 pp. 42-45. Verified concomitant secondary impact vs parallel macro shift instruction, sentence examples, and chapter practice exercises (skm2-p1-c9-q3, q4, q10).

grammarItem: 〜次第だ / 〜につけて
instructionalDetails: Covers 〜次第だ (outcome depends entirely upon condition: チームワーク次第だ) vs 〜につけて (inevitable emotional stirring upon every exposure: 写真を見るにつけて, 言葉を思い出すにつけて).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N2 pp. 42-45. Verified contingency outcome vs emotional recurrence trigger instruction, sentence examples, and chapter practice exercises (skm2-p1-c9-q6, q7, q12).

grammarItem: 〜抜きで / 〜抜きにして（は） / 〜抜きには
instructionalDetails: Covers 〜抜きで (dispensing with formality or habitual elements: 冗談抜きで, 挨拶は抜きにして) and 〜抜きにしては / 〜抜きには (hypothetical failure without an indispensable contributor: 貢献抜きにしては語れない, 指導力抜きには不可能).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N2 pp. 46-51. Verified exclusion of formality and essential-element conditionality, sentence examples, and chapter practice exercises (skm2-p1-c10-q1, q2, q7, q12).

grammarItem: 〜やら〜やら / 〜というか〜というか
instructionalDetails: Covers 〜やら〜やら (heterogeneous jumble of tasks, disasters, or burdens: 搬出やら手続きやら, 財布を落とすやら乗り遅れるやら) vs 〜というか〜というか (hesitation between two complementary or conflicting characterizations: 勇気があるというか無謀というか, 個性派というか奇抜というか).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N2 pp. 46-51. Verified disorderly enumeration vs evaluative hesitation distinction, sentence examples, and chapter practice exercises (skm2-p1-c10-q3, q4, q8, q9).

grammarItem: 〜にしても〜にしても / 〜といった
instructionalDetails: Covers 〜にしても〜にしても (inclusive application regardless of which bipolar choice is selected: 賛成にしても反対にしても, 進学するにしても就職するにしても) vs 〜といった (bundling representative exemplars into a superordinate category: 寿司や天ぷらといった和食, 納豆やキムチといった発酵食品).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N2 pp. 46-51. Verified bipolar condition inclusion vs superordinate exemplar bundling, sentence examples, and chapter practice exercises (skm2-p1-c10-q5, q6, q10, q11).

grammarItem: 〜にかかわらず / 〜にかかわりなく
instructionalDetails: Covers 〜にかかわらず / 〜にかかわりなく. Action or rule applies uniformly unaffected by weather, attendance, presence/absence, or natural dichotomy (e.g. 雨天・晴天にかかわらず, 参加費の有無にかかわりなく, 理由の如何にかかわらず).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N2 pp. 52-55. Verified uniform unconditioned application instruction, sentence examples, and chapter practice exercises (skm2-p1-c11-q2, q7, q12).

grammarItem: 〜はともかく（として）
instructionalDetails: Covers 〜はともかく（として）. Temporarily shelves value assessment or quality evaluation of element A in order to emphasize the definite merit or necessity of element B (e.g. デザインの良し悪しはともかく, 値段が高いか安いかはともかくとして).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N2 pp. 52-55. Verified evaluative postponement instruction, contrast with はさておき, sentence examples, and chapter practice exercises (skm2-p1-c11-q4, q9).

grammarItem: 〜はさておき
instructionalDetails: Covers 〜はさておき. Explicitly sets aside a secondary matter or conversational digression to redirect focus toward immediate essential priorities or central business (e.g. 経費の計算はさておき人命救助, 冗談話はさておき新工場の安全性).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N2 pp. 52-55. Verified priority redirection discourse marker instruction, sentence examples, and chapter practice exercises (skm2-p1-c11-q5, q10).

grammarItem: 〜を問わず / 〜もかまわず
instructionalDetails: Covers 〜を問わず (formal removal of attribute restrictions: 年齢・国籍を問わず, 昼夜を問わず, 経験の有無を問わず) vs 〜もかまわず (blatant disregard for surrounding norms, danger, or eyes: 周囲の迷惑もかまわず, 泥で汚れるのもかまわず).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N2 pp. 52-55. Verified attribute-blind inclusivity vs norm-disregarding behavior distinction, sentence examples, and chapter practice exercises (skm2-p1-c11-q1, q3, q6, q8, q11).

grammarItem: 〜どころか
instructionalDetails: Covers 〜どころか. Sharply contrasts an expected or mild baseline state X against a reality that is far more extreme, diametrically opposed, or dramatically aggravated (e.g. 給料が上がるどころかボーナス削減, 風邪は治るどころか肺炎寸前, 感謝されるどころか怒られた).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N2 pp. 56-59. Verified extreme reversal/aggravation instruction, sentence examples, and chapter practice exercises (skm2-p1-c12-q1, q5, q9).

grammarItem: 〜わけがない / 〜ものか / 〜というものではない
instructionalDetails: Covers 〜わけがない / 〜はずがない (objective logical impossibility grounded in character or physical proof: 裏切るわけがない, 知っているはずがない, 否認し続けられるわけがない) vs 〜ものか / 〜もんか (emotional defiance and unwavering rejection: 二度と行くものか, 諦めてたまるもんか, 泣き言を言うものか) vs 〜というものではない / 〜というものでもない (philosophical partial negation: 幸福が手に入るというものではない, 大成功できるというものでもない, 喜ばれるというものではない).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N2 pp. 56-59. Verified three-way modal negation taxonomy (logical impossibility, subjective defiance, rational qualification), sentence examples, and chapter practice exercises (skm2-p1-c12-q2, q3, q4, q6, q7, q8, q10, q11, q12).

grammarItem: 〜とは / 〜といえば / 〜となると・〜となれば
instructionalDetails: Covers 〜とは (amazed topic marker foregrounding an astonishing or philosophical reality: 愛する家族に看取られるとは, 激怒して机を叩いたとは, 初日に無断欠勤したとは) vs 〜といえば (evoking classic representative associations: 春の風物詩といえばお花見, 北海道グルメといえばラーメン, 夏休みの定番といえばキャンプ) vs 〜となると / 〜となれば (threshold condition transition to sober practical reality: マイホームを購入するとなると, 海外へ単身赴任するとなれば, 起業するとなると).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N2 pp. 60-63. Verified pragmatic topic presentation system, sentence examples, and chapter practice exercises (skm2-p1-c13-q1, q2, q3, q5, q6, q7, q9, q10, q11).

grammarItem: 〜といったら（ありはしない／ない）
instructionalDetails: Covers 〜といったら. Expresses overwhelming, words-defying magnitude of visual, emotional, or sensory experience (e.g. オーロラの美しさといったら, ご来光の荘厳さといったら, 息子の喜びようといったら).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N2 pp. 60-63. Verified superlative emotional magnitude instruction, noun-head attachment, sentence examples, and chapter practice exercises (skm2-p1-c13-q4, q8, q12).

grammarItem: 〜一方で
instructionalDetails: Covers 〜一方で. Objectively juxtaposes two contrasting aspects, concurrent social realities, or dual characteristics of a single entity (e.g. ネットの利便性の一方で個人情報流出の危険性, 地方都市の落ち着く生活の一方で不便さ).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N2 pp. 64-67. Verified concurrent duality instruction, sentence examples, and chapter practice exercises (skm2-p1-c14-q1, q5, q9).

grammarItem: 〜反面
instructionalDetails: Covers 〜反面. Highlights the inherent opposite flip-side / shadow side coexisting within the very same situation (e.g. 一人暮らしの気楽さの反面孤独感, 薬効の強さの反面副作用, 超小型軽量の反面バッテリーの短さ).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N2 pp. 64-67. Verified coexisting flip-side duality instruction, contrast vs 一方で, sentence examples, and dedicated chapter exercises (skm2-p1-c14-q2, q6, q10, skm2-c14-ex-hanmen).

grammarItem: 〜反面・〜わりに・〜にしては
instructionalDetails: Covers comparative contrast and discrepancy markers: 〜反面 (coexisting flip-side duality) vs 〜わりに（は） (discrepancy from general benchmark/price) vs 〜にしては (surprising deviation from concrete title/standard).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N2 pp. 64-67. Verified comparative discrepancy and duality contrasts, sentence examples, and chapter practice exercises (skm2-p1-c14-q3, q4, q7, q8, q11, q12).

grammarItem: 〜ものの・〜とはいうものの・〜といっても・〜からといって
instructionalDetails: Covers concession and qualification: 〜ものの / 〜とはいうものの (acknowledging factual premise then qualifying) vs 〜といっても (narrowing/correcting an overstatement) vs 〜からといって (denying simplistic inferences).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N2 pp. 64-67. Verified concession/qualification system, sentence examples, and chapter practice exercises.

grammarItem: 〜くせに
instructionalDetails: Covers 〜くせに. Expresses reproach, contempt, or sharp criticism for an unjustified contradiction in the subject’s demeanor (e.g. 何もしようとしないくせに文句ばかり, お金持ちのくせにケチ, 締め切りを守らないくせに部下を叱責). Speaker cannot be the subject.
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N2 pp. 68-73. Verified critical concession instruction, subject-restriction rules, contrast vs のに, sentence examples, and dedicated chapter exercises (skm2-p1-c15-q1, q6, q11, skm2-c15-ex-kuse).

grammarItem: 〜といっても
instructionalDetails: Covers 〜といっても. Prevents exaggeration by qualifying the reality of a preceding statement (e.g. 料理ができるといっても簡単なものだけ, 家から駅まで近いといっても急坂15分, 日本に住んでいたといってもわずか2年). Implemented in study card [added-n2-14-92].
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N2 pp. 68-73. Verified qualification/restraint instruction, sentence examples in added-n2-14-92, and chapter practice exercises (skm2-p1-c15-q2, q7, q12).

grammarItem: 〜としたら / 〜とすれば
instructionalDetails: Covers 〜としたら / 〜とすれば. Pure hypothetical simulation establishing an imagined condition and deducing subsequent action/consequence (e.g. 過去に戻れるとしたら, 水没地帯だとすれば). Implemented in study card [added-n2-15-93].
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N2 pp. 68-73. Verified hypothetical deduction instruction, sentence examples in added-n2-15-93, and chapter practice exercises (skm2-p1-c15-q3, q8).

grammarItem: 〜としたら・〜とすると・〜としても
instructionalDetails: Covers hypothetical conditional family: 〜としたら (suppositional simulation) vs 〜とすると (logical sequence) vs 〜としても (even granting the hypothetical).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N2 pp. 68-73. Verified suppositional condition system, sentence examples, and chapter practice exercises.

grammarItem: 〜ないことには・〜を抜きにしては・〜通りに・〜に反して
instructionalDetails: Covers prerequisite negative conditions (〜ないことには, 〜を抜きにしては) and alignment vs divergence markers (〜通りに, 〜に反して).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N2 pp. 68-73. Verified alignment and expectation-divergence instruction, sentence examples, and chapter practice exercises (skm2-p1-c15-q4, q5, q9, q10).

grammarItem: 〜からといって
instructionalDetails: Covers 〜からといって (denying simplistic, absolute inferences: 給料が高いからといって過酷な労働に耐えられるわけではない, 親が医者だからといって医学部に進む理由はない). Implemented in study card [added-n2-14-92].
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N2 pp. 74-77. Verified inference-denial instruction, sentence examples in added-n2-14-92, and chapter practice exercises (skm2-p1-c16-q1, q4, q7, q10).

grammarItem: 〜にしては
instructionalDetails: Covers 〜にしては (surprising deviation from a concrete standard or title: プロの料理人が作ったにしては塩辛い, 真冬の北海道にしては暖かい). Implemented in study card [added-n2-19-101].
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N2 pp. 74-77. Verified benchmark deviation instruction, sentence examples in added-n2-19-101, and chapter practice exercises.

grammarItem: 〜だけに・〜だけのことはある
instructionalDetails: Covers 〜だけに (heightened emotional resonance / magnified outcome due to special reason: 失敗経験があるだけに慎重, 前評判が高かっただけに落胆が大きい, 念願の初優勝だけに喜びがひとしお) vs 〜だけのことはある (merited praise fitting status, prestige, or grueling effort: 10年特訓しただけのことはある, 三ツ星レストランだけのことはある, 国際コンクール優勝者だけのことはある).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N2 pp. 74-77. Verified magnified resonance vs merited praise distinction, sentence examples, and chapter practice exercises (skm2-p1-c16-q2, q3, q5, q6, q8, q9, q11, q12).

grammarItem: 〜ことから
instructionalDetails: Covers 〜ことから. Points to an objective fact, evidence, feature, or origin that gives rise to a name, deduction, discovery, or conclusion (e.g. 鳥の羽に似ている姿から白鳥山と呼ばれる, 指紋が残されていたことから複数犯と断定, 真面目であったことから特待生に選ばれた).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N2 pp. 78-81. Verified objective naming origin and forensic grounds instruction, contrast vs から, sentence examples, and dedicated chapter exercises (skm2-p1-c17-q1, q4, q7, q10, skm2-c17-ex-koto).

grammarItem: 〜わけではない / 〜というわけではない
instructionalDetails: Covers 〜わけではない / 〜というわけではない. Partial negation qualifying a statement to prevent absolute assumptions (e.g. お酒が全く飲めないわけではない, 写真が撮れるというわけではない, 人間性まで全否定しているわけではない, 絶対に病気にかからないわけではない).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N2 pp. 78-81. Verified partial negation instruction, contrast vs わけがない, sentence examples, and dedicated chapter exercises (skm2-p1-c17-q2, q5, q8, q11, skm2-c17-ex-wake).

grammarItem: 〜ことから・〜ばかりに
instructionalDetails: Covers objective factual derivation (〜ことから) vs bitter regret from an unfortunate singular misstep (〜ばかりに: 目先のわずかな利益に眩んだばかりに, 集合時間を勘違いしたばかりに, 余計な一言を口走ったばかりに, パスポート更新を忘れたばかりに).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N2 pp. 78-81. Verified objective derivation vs poignant regret contrast, sentence examples, and chapter practice exercises (skm2-p1-c17-q3, q6, q9, q12).

grammarItem: 〜ことだし・〜のことだから
instructionalDetails: Covers natural conversational justification (〜ことだし) and inference based on known character/reliability (〜のことだから).
evidence: Physical textbook verification: SKM N2 pp. 78-81. Verified conversational justification and character-based inference instruction, sentence examples, and chapter practice exercises.
